title: Pittsfield Gym Says the January Rush Isn't What It Used to Be

facts.fact: Planet Fitness in Pittsfield is described as having a $15-a-month membership.
facts.quote: With its $15-a-month membership and judgment-free zone branding, Planet has solidified its spot as the city's fitness hub.

facts.fact: A Planet Fitness front-desk employee named Gary estimated that new sign-ups in January 2026 were about a quarter of the prior year's number; this is an anecdotal staff estimate, not reported data.
facts.quote: "I'd say a quarter of what the number was last year," Gary told me.
